title: Arborescent
summary: ARBORES'CENT, adjective 1. Resembling a tree; having the figure of a tree; dendritical. 2. From herbaceous becoming woody. ARBORES'CENT STAR-FISH, noun a species of asterias, called also caput Medusae

inlines.v: ARBORES'CENT, adjective 1. Resembling a tree; having the figure of a tree; dendritical. 2. From herbaceous becoming woody. ARBORES'CENT STAR-FISH, noun a species of asterias, called also caput Medusae. [See Starfish.]
